description: Retrieval eval over the sample corpus (knowledge_base/ + sample_corpus/pdf). A retrieved chunk counts as a hit for a relevant unit when its file name matches `path` and, if given, its `section` (markdown heading) or `page` matches. PDF questions are graded at document level. Questions are paraphrased so that pure keyword overlap is not guaranteed.
